title: Consider re-licensing to AL v2.0, as RocksDB has just done
one_line_why: RocksDB re‑licensing to Apache‑2.0/GPL‑2 demonstrates feasibility for React and reflects broader open‑source license harmonization trends.
one_line_summary: React should adopt a dual Apache‑2.0/GPL‑2 license to align with ASF licensing policies.
